questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to diligent?
questions.explanation: Diligent describes someone who works carefully and steadily, so hardworking is the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to reluctant?
questions.explanation: Reluctant describes someone who is hesitant or unwilling to act.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to verify?
questions.explanation: To verify something is to check and confirm that it is true or accurate.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to rigid?
questions.explanation: Rigid means stiff or unable to bend, while flexible means able to bend.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to conceal?
questions.explanation: Conceal means to hide; reveal means to make known or visible.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to scarce?
questions.explanation: Scarce means limited or hard to find, whereas plentiful means abundant.

questions.prompt: Petal is to flower as page is to ____.
questions.explanation: A petal is part of a flower, just as a page is part of a book.

questions.prompt: Thermometer is to temperature as scale is to ____.
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature, while a scale measures weight.

questions.prompt: Sapling is to tree as calf is to ____.
questions.explanation: A sapling is a young tree, and a calf is a young cow.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Copper, silver, and iron are metals; granite is a rock.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with sonnet, haiku, and limerick?
questions.explanation: A sonnet, haiku, limerick, and ode are all forms of poetry.

questions.prompt: Robin, sparrow, and finch are all members of which group?
questions.explanation: Robins, sparrows, and finches are all birds.

questions.prompt: Every student on the debate team practices on Tuesday. Lena is on the debate team. Which conclusion must be true?

choices.C: Every Tuesday student joins the debate team.

questions.explanation: The rule applies to every debate-team student, and Lena is identified as one.

questions.prompt: Four folders—green, red, blue, and yellow—stand in a row. Green is immediately before red. Blue is last. Yellow is not first. Which folder must be first?
questions.explanation: Blue is last, and yellow cannot be first; only green can begin the green-red pair.

questions.prompt: If the library is open, its front light is on. The front light is not on. Which conclusion follows logically?
questions.explanation: If being open requires the light to be on, an unlit light proves the library is not open.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to tranquil?
questions.explanation: Tranquil means calm and free from disturbance, so peaceful is the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to elaborate?
questions.explanation: Elaborate describes something containing many carefully developed details.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to diminish?
questions.explanation: To diminish is to become or make smaller, which means decrease.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to temporary?
questions.explanation: Temporary means lasting a limited time; permanent means lasting indefinitely.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to cautious?
questions.explanation: Cautious behavior avoids risk, while reckless behavior ignores it.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to expand?
questions.explanation: Expand means grow larger; contract means become smaller.

questions.prompt: Carpenter is to hammer as painter is to ____.
questions.explanation: A carpenter uses a hammer, just as a painter uses a brush.

questions.prompt: Wool is to sweater as clay is to ____.
questions.explanation: Wool is material made into a sweater, and clay is material made into pottery.

questions.prompt: Hunger is to food as fatigue is to ____.
questions.explanation: Food responds to hunger, just as rest responds to fatigue.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Whisper, murmur, and mutter are ways of speaking quietly; sprint is a way of running.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with cedar, maple, and birch?
questions.explanation: Cedar, maple, birch, and elm are kinds of trees.

questions.prompt: Compass, ruler, and protractor are all members of which group?
questions.explanation: A compass, ruler, and protractor are tools used to measure or construct geometric figures.

questions.prompt: Ava presents before Ben. Carlos presents after Ben. Dana presents before Ava. Who must present first?
questions.explanation: The required order is Dana, Ava, Ben, Carlos, so Dana must be first.

questions.prompt: No glass objects are flexible. Every item in box K is flexible. Which statement must be true?

choices.B: Some glass objects are in box K.
choices.C: No item in box K is made of glass.
choices.D: Every flexible object is in box K.

questions.correctAnswer: No item in box K is made of glass.
questions.explanation: All box K items are flexible, and no glass object can be flexible.

questions.prompt: A workshop occurs on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday. If it occurs Monday, the coach cannot attend. If the coach attends, the workshop is not Friday. The coach attends. On which day must the workshop occur?
questions.explanation: Attendance rules out Monday and Friday, leaving Wednesday as the only possible day.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to resilient?
questions.explanation: Resilient describes an ability to recover and adjust, making adaptable the closest choice.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to concise?
questions.explanation: Concise language expresses an idea clearly in few words, so it is brief.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to obstruct?
questions.explanation: To obstruct something is to block its movement or progress.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to generous?
questions.explanation: Generous means willing to give; stingy means unwilling to give.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to artificial?
questions.explanation: Artificial means made rather than naturally occurring, so natural is its opposite.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to frequent?
questions.explanation: Frequent means happening often, while rare means happening seldom.

questions.prompt: Orchard is to fruit as vineyard is to ____.
questions.explanation: An orchard produces fruit, just as a vineyard produces grapes.

questions.prompt: Apprentice is to expert as dawn is to ____.
questions.explanation: An apprentice develops into an expert, while dawn develops into morning.

questions.prompt: Glove is to hand as sheath is to ____.
questions.explanation: A glove covers and protects a hand, while a sheath covers and protects a sword.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: The other choices are two-dimensional polygons; a cylinder is a three-dimensional solid.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with violin, cello, and harp?
questions.explanation: Violin, cello, harp, and guitar are stringed instruments.

questions.prompt: Mercury, Venus, and Mars are all members of which group?
questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus, and Mars are planets in the solar system.

questions.prompt: Exactly one of two doors is unlocked. The north door is locked. Which statement must be true?

choices.C: The north door will open later.

questions.explanation: Exactly one door is unlocked, and it cannot be the locked north door.

questions.prompt: A red token cannot be beside a blue token. Three tokens—red, green, and blue—are placed in a row. Which token must be in the middle?
questions.explanation: Green must separate red and blue because those two cannot be adjacent.

questions.prompt: All certified guides completed the safety course. Some museum volunteers are certified guides. Which conclusion must be true?

choices.B: Some museum volunteers completed the safety course.

questions.correctAnswer: Some museum volunteers completed the safety course.
questions.explanation: Some volunteers are certified guides, and every certified guide completed the course.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to vigilant?
questions.explanation: Vigilant means staying alert and watchful for possible problems.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to feasible?
questions.explanation: Feasible describes something that can be done, meaning possible.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to retain?
questions.explanation: To retain something is to continue to have or keep it.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to vacant?
questions.explanation: Vacant means empty or unoccupied; occupied is its opposite.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to approve?
questions.explanation: To approve is to accept or authorize, while to reject is to refuse.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to transparent?
questions.explanation: Transparent material permits sight through it; opaque material does not.

questions.prompt: Aviary is to birds as aquarium is to ____.
questions.explanation: An aviary houses birds, just as an aquarium houses fish.

questions.prompt: Blueprint is to building as recipe is to ____.
questions.explanation: A blueprint guides the creation of a building, while a recipe guides the creation of a meal.

questions.prompt: Spark is to fire as idea is to ____.
questions.explanation: A spark can begin a fire, just as an idea can begin an invention.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Applaud, cheer, and praise express approval; complain expresses dissatisfaction.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with ruby, emerald, and sapphire?
questions.explanation: Ruby, emerald, sapphire, and diamond are gemstones.

questions.prompt: Novel, biography, and dictionary are all members of which group?
questions.explanation: A novel, biography, and dictionary are all types of books.

questions.prompt: A package is delivered only if someone signs for it. The package was delivered. Which statement must be true?

choices.B: The recipient was home all day.

questions.explanation: Delivery occurs only when the required signature is provided.

questions.prompt: Four runners—J, K, L, and M—finish a race. J finishes after K but before L. M finishes after L. Who finishes second?
questions.explanation: The only possible order is K, J, L, M, so J finishes second.

questions.prompt: Either the oak trail or the lake trail is open, but not both. If the oak trail is open, the bridge is inspected. The bridge was not inspected. Which trail is open?
questions.explanation: The uninspected bridge proves the oak trail is closed; exactly one trail is open, so the lake trail is open.
